name: Oshikake Gohoushi! ~Boku no H na Maid-san~
original_name: おしかけ御奉仕！～僕のHなメイドさん～
source:
Main character is a good-looking boy. He has everything since childhood, so now decides to live alone and pass exams to the school he chooses. But parents send maid Akiko to assist him at new place. And she sneaks into his bed to assist with any remaining needs he might have.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/07/vn-of-month-march-2008-12riven-climinal.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角御神樂潤一相貌英俊，自幼生活優渥。如今，他決定獨自生活，並考入自己選擇的學校。父母卻派來女僕藤倉明子，到新住處照料他。就連剩下的種種需求，她也會鑽進他的被窩親自滿足。

[譯自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/07/vn-of-month-march-2008-12riven-climinal.html]vndbreview[/url]]
